split_note: Straight picks from the 30-draw store-branch pool (cat5 14 / cat6 16; no build draws at all). No synthesis. Build lives on in the turn-0 seeded programmes, so the choice is what new direction to add: harden first or evaluate first. Turn-1 resolution differs per arm (ai_capability 55.0/54.0/53.5), so it is not shown before the choice.

situation.title: Open Weights Capability Jump
situation.description: An open-weight release lands within a few months of the closed frontier. It is downloaded hundreds of thousands of times in the first week, and whatever capability it carries is now on private hardware permanently and beyond recall. `openweight_capability` moves to within 5–10 points of `ai_capability` at a stroke.

situation.title: Taiwan Tension Rises
situation.description: Extended military exercises, shipping insurance premiums rising, a diplomatic expulsion. Nothing that has not happened before, at a scale that is slightly harder to dismiss. **This is a precursor: it opens the Taiwan gate for the next 3 turns.**

situation.title: emergent_intrusion_tooling_copycats
situation.description: Forensic samples of the autumn industrial-intrusion tooling leak publicly and are repackaged into copycat intrusion kits, triggering a wave of low-skill probes against European municipal utilities and grid suppliers.

commitment: Secure independent capacity and resilience so the Union can withstand coercion and absorb AI harm
